title: FRONT OF DASH SEALING
summary: Sealer points on the engine side of the dash panel (firewall). 53a sealer at the dash mat (insulator) retainer holes, 53e around the fuse panel opening after the fuse panel is installed, 53f at the speedometer cable grommet, 53g at the A/C harness grommet and 53h at the A/C vacuum hose grommet. No parts, only sealing. All models.

materials.where: dash mat retainer holes on the LH side of the dash panel

materials.description: Apply around the fuse panel opening at front of dash after fuse panel has been installed
materials.where: fuse panel opening, lower RH side of the dash panel (front view)
speedometer cable grommet, upper RH side of the dash panel (front view)
A/C harness grommet hole, upper center of the dash panel
A/C vacuum hose grommet, center of the dash panel

fastening.note: 53a sealer at the dash mat retainer holes in the dash panel.
53e sealer around the fuse panel opening on the front (engine side) of the dash, applied after the fuse panel is installed.
53f sealer at the speedometer cable grommet.
53g sealer at the A/C harness grommet.
53h sealer at the A/C vacuum hose grommet.

notes_internal: Sealing-only sheet, no callout list; legend key [A] printed only beside 53a.
Rev 1 (circled 1 at 53h): handwritten letter after '53' unclear (a or g), written 53?.
Left/right positions are as seen in the front view of the dash panel.
